verdict.rationale: Apify documents smart rotation of datacenter and residential IPs to avoid blocking. Its SDK SessionPool rotates proxy IPs together with cookies, and you can mix Apify Proxy with your own or third-party proxies. The evidence does not show requests being automatically retried through an escalating chain of proxies when a block is detected, so this is rotation rather than block-triggered failover. Missing for 10: explicit block-detection-triggered retry, tiered proxy fallback chain (e.g., datacenter→residential escalation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
